concept: Hide forward Barracks, mass early Marauders to force a fast defensive response, then transition into a compact bio army if the proxy does not end the game.
rules: Check emergency_defence first, then proxy_assault. Otherwise use opening, proxy_construction, proxy_assault, bio_transition.
Use two SCVs to establish two forward Barracks at a pathable proxy location and do not sacrifice both builders needlessly.
Favor Marauders before roughly 26 workers; add Marines and Medivacs only after the initial all-in creates room to grow.
Engage defended positions only when the local fight is at least close. Retreat, regroup, or hit a weaker location rather than trading into static defence.

enter_when: The proxy workers have not yet reached the forward build location.
phases.goal: Start the two-Barracks proxy while preserving enough home income for immediate production.
guidance: Train the earliest SCVs, build a Supply Depot at 13 supply, and send two workers toward a forward location.
Do not spend on early expansion or nonessential technology before the forward Barracks are active.

enter_when: One or both forward Barracks are being built.
Two ready proxy Barracks do not yet exist.
phases.goal: Complete the production anchor and start the Marauder timing.
guidance: Complete two forward Barracks and begin Marauder production from every ready Barracks.
Start Concussive Shells when Marauder production is underway and resources permit.
Use early Marauders to protect the proxy and deny enemy workers that try to stop it.

enter_when: A usable Marauder force is near the enemy or moving across the map.
phases.goal: Exploit the forward production advantage before the opponent stabilizes.
guidance: Pressure workers, production, or unfinished defences and reinforce continuously with Marauders.
Use Concussive Shells to chase vulnerable targets or disengage from stronger forces.
If a wall blocks the main entrance, attack an exposed expansion, production building, or worker line instead of forcing the choke.

enter_when: The initial proxy has not ended the game.
Resources allow normal supporting production or a second base.
phases.goal: Convert surviving pressure into a functional bio economy.
guidance: Expand when the mineral bank is above the aggressive threshold and the army can protect the timing.
Add Refineries, transition toward Marauder, Marine, and Medivac, and start infantry upgrades.
Keep the forward Barracks as reinforcement production while the main base develops normal infrastructure.

enter_when: Enemy forces threaten the main base or worker line before the proxy force has gained control.
phases.goal: Prevent a counterattack from ending the game.
guidance: Defend at home with nearby units and necessary SCVs.
If the proxy is isolated, regroup the army toward a safe position rather than continuing a losing attack.
